assessment: The manuscript addresses how extracellular vesicles (EV) are targeted to their recipient cells once they are produced and released. The study shows that a transmembrane protein Sas gets incorporated into EVs, and this protein binds to its receptor Ptp10D on target cells, thus targeting the EVs. The expression of dARC1 in the EV-producing cells leads to the increased expression of the protein dARC1 protein and mRNAs in the recipient cells.
